speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: What draws the sap, and what thins difference?
premises: On limited step, measurer's step gained, its spread by own-own gleam contracting — she who draws the all-sap of the station-yoked day-sun (mārtaṇḍasya normalized).
Drawing forcibly — may she thin my difference from world-fear.
inference: Sun-sap drawn forcibly; difference thinned from world-fear prayed.
